summary: Beta.4 fixes circuit ownership after rebuilding or unloading, rejects unsafe native solver results, and restores handheld readings on wire and battery/generator connectors. API 1.0.0 and existing saves stay compatible.
changes: Keep matrix batches with their owning solver and regroup disconnected circuits after rebuilds and unloads.
Reject failed factorizations, invalid permutations and nonfinite results; hold stored energy and preserve diagnostics during rejection.
Keep multimeter readings consistent with accepted terminal samples, including compressed wires and refreshed battery/generator connectors.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.231 or 21.1.248, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
